visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Four young men stand on a sidewalk in front of the ARTY Inn Shinsaibashi hotel, posing for a group photo with various hand gestures and smiles. A man in a purple t-shirt and black backpack films them. The lighting is bright natural daylight. (2) The man in the purple shirt approaches the group and begins a conversation with high energy. The four men, wearing casual summer attire like white t-shirts and baseball caps, respond with curious expressions. (3) The scene transitions to the group walking together on an urban street. The camera follows them at eye-level, showing the city environment with road signs and buildings. (4) They stop in a narrow alleyway with a green metal fence and a concrete pillar covered in graffiti. The man in purple shows them reference photos on his smartphone. (5) One man in a white tank top mimics a pose from the photo, holding a green bottled drink against the fence while looking away. A young woman with short hair joins the group, watching the process. (6) Another man in a white t-shirt and glasses poses while the others film him. They all look at the results on a phone screen, laughing and smiling. (7) The group stands together one last time, exchanging farewells, handshakes, and waves before walking off-camera in different directions.
